news.title: 马斯克与奥特曼的AI竞争随IPO竞赛升温达沸点
news.snippet: 随着xAI与OpenAI上市进程加速，Elon Musk与Sam Altman在人工智能领域的竞争日趋白热化。
news.raw_snippet: # Musk and Altman’s AI rivalry reaches boiling point as IPO race heats up. As SpaceX and OpenAI race toward IPOs, a tiny circle of tech leaders tightens its grip on AI’s future. ## Elon Musk and Sam Altman can’t stop thinking about each other. Sam Altman and Elon Musk are engaged in a contest of one-upsmanship with stakes in the trillions of dollars, and the heated rivalry was on full display last week. The disclosure on Wednesday shed light on SpaceX’s usually secretive finances, showing that it is plowing billions of dollars into its AI subsidiary, xAI, and had a capital expenditure last year of more than $20bn against $18.7bn in revenue for 2025. With all three AI businesses set to go public this year, each at valuations of hundreds of billions or more than a trillion dollars, it’s one of the most blockbuster periods for public offerings in market history.

news.snippet: 人工智能公司Anthropic已完成最新融资/战略合作（原文信息不完整，保留核心主体）。
news.raw_snippet: # Maeil Business Newspaper Korea's No. 1 Economic Media. # Maeil Business News Korea. ### News. # Maeil Business Newspaper. ## Anthropic, an artificial intelligence (AI) company, has completed the appointment of a representativ.. Anthropic, an artificial intelligence (AI) company, has completed the appointment of a representative of a Korean subsidiary, and has begun full-fledged business in Korea. Anthropic announced on the 27th that it has appointed Choi Ki-young, former general manager of Snowflake, as the Korean representative. In addition, senior executives of Anthropic will visit Korea within weeks to officially establish a Seoul office and meet with major domestic customers. CEO Choi said, "Domestic companies have both technical capabilities and a willingness to be responsible for AI, so they are exactly in line with the values pursued by Anthropic," adding, "For this reason, we have joined Anthropic and will develop our Korean business from a long-term perspective.". "We will start our domestic business in earnest with the opening of the Seoul office.".

news.title: 奥特曼质疑AI引发的工作末日论
news.snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman质疑"人工智能将导致大规模失业"的末日预测，认为AI将创造新就业机会。
news.raw_snippet: # Altman Questions AI-Induced Job Apocalypse. OpenAI CEO doubts AI will cause a global job apocalypse. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has expressed skepticism that the advancement of artificial intelligence will lead to a global “job apocalypse.” This was reported by Reuters. According to him, AI has not yet caused the large-scale reduction in office jobs that he himself anticipated following the launch of ChatGPT in 2022. It seemed that by now the impact on entry-level office positions would be greater,” the entrepreneur said at the Commonwealth Bank of Australia conference in Sydney. The CEO stated that the company “roughly accurately” assessed the technological development of LLM, but erred in predicting its immediate social and economic consequences. As an example, Altman shared that he tried using AI for responses in Slack and email but then returned to personal communication. The decision was linked to the company’s transition to a “more compact, flat, and AI-focused” structure.
